g.text: Vectoring dose–D correlation | every order, including negative and unavailable
Segmented: 13/15 positive, median 0.829 | Smooth: 9/15 positive, median 0.600
Coefficients are read from saved full-range summaries, not computed from median curves. All 20 planned order curves per shape are accounted for.
No p-values or confidence intervals: orders share the same scene. These results concern the two 15 km stimuli, not vectoring in general.
